sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/six-mile-campground (read 2026-11-20): Current Conditions 'This campground remains open as weather and road conditions permit access. Visitors should be aware that no fees are charged and no amenities, facilities, or services are provided throughout the winter months.'; 'Located in a saddle above the North Platte River, providing access to the North Platte River and Platte River Wilderness Area, Six Mile Gap Campground is 2 miles off of Highway 230. recreation.gov campsite catalog 10244162 (2026-11-20): 9 standard nonelectric sites; 004-008 reservable online, 001-003 and 009 not; 007-009 pull-through; no length or equipment data; water hookup 'No'

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (1.2 km frame with site points): the loop sits on open sage in the saddle; the North Platte is ~400 m east in its canyon; stored pin inside the loop (~35 m from the site centroid 41.04425,-106.39968). The FS page's point 41.0479,-106.39902 is ~400 m north in open sage, not the campground.

values.note: Sites 4-8 book online; 1-3 and 9 are first-come. All sites go first-come after Labor Day.

note: Medicine Bow NF campground (Six Mile Gap) in an open sagebrush saddle above the North Platte River, 2 miles up FR 492 off WY-230, about 27 miles southeast of Encampment. Access to the river and the Platte River Wilderness, with separate parking for hikers and floaters. No shade. Bear canisters for food storage. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov + catalog read: 9 sites (7-9 pull-through), max trailer 30 ft, vault toilet, hand-pump water, no hookups, $20 + $5 extra vehicle, 8 people, 14 days. Booking some_sites (1-3, 9 FCFS; all FCFS after Labor Day). Season left derived (FS mid-June to mid-Sept vs rec.gov sales May 1-Oct 31 and an FS winter-open notice - flag). Not waterfront holds (river ~400 m). Phone empty -> (307) 326-5258. Pin fine.
